text: Stepping into this space, I am struck by a sensation of anticipation and curiosity. The architecture feels modern, almost clinical, its glass walls inviting contemplation of transparency and separation. Moving forward, I find myself surrounded by bold colors and large letters—R + D—evoking the themes of creation, innovation, and the unknown. There is a certain thrill in the juxtaposition of structure and imagination, and I feel as though I am teetering on the edge of discovery, eager to immerse myself in the ideas and objects curated here.
